top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The 5 staff files reviewed did not have form 2912 included.
